name: Roundfruit Panicgrass
desc: Roundfruit Panicgrass (Dichanthelium sphaerocarpon): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Dichanthelium sphaerocarpon, also called Panicum polyanthes, common name round-seed panic grass, is a plant found in North America. It is listed as endangered in Michigan.
